run.question:
Alertmanager alert CheckoutPlaceOrderErrorRatioHigh (severity critical) is firing for service otel-demo/checkout since 2026-11-16T09:05:54Z.
Alert expression (PromQL): label_replace(label_replace((sum by (k8s_namespace_name, service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{k8s_namespace_name="otel-demo",service_name="checkout",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",span_name=~".*CheckoutService/PlaceOrder",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[5m]))) / (sum by (k8s_namespace_name, service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{k8s_namespace_name="otel-demo",service_name="checkout",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",span_name=~".*CheckoutService/PlaceOrder"}[5m]))), "namespace", "$1", "k8s_namespace_name", "(.*)"), "service", "$1", "service_name", "(.*)") > 0.5
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The alert reproduces: over 09:03:00–09:06:00Z the otel-demo/checkout PlaceOrder SERVER span error ratio is exactly 1.0 (100%). The failures are not produced in checkout's own logic but in its dependency: checkout's only failing RPC is oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge with gRPC status code 2, and payment's own grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge server spans show STATUS_CODE_ERROR with identical counts and a 1.0 error ratio, carrying the exception 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' thrown at /usr/src/app/charge.js:37 in 598–825 µs (fast application-level rejection, not a timeout). Payment and flagd pods were unchanged all hour, while OpenFeature/flagd telemetry shows the feature_flag_key="paymentFailure" flag reporting result variant "off" earlier and result variant "100%" from the 09:01:54Z evaluation onward, and payment is the only service that resolves a flagd float value (grpc.flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveFloat), appearing only from the 09:03:54Z evaluation. flagd's flagSync span also first appears at the 09:02:54Z evaluation. The checkout Deployment rollout at 08:52:20Z (pod checkout-75684774cb-rrnkq → checkout-677db95fd-g5vc9, same image digest sha256:5ab0d7b9...) is a real change in the window but is not what broke this path: no checkout error spans exist for the ~11 minutes between the rollout and 09:03:54Z, and the exceptions originate inside payment's charge handler. Best-supported cause: the paymentFailure feature flag flipped to a 100% failure variant, making every PaymentService/Charge call fail, which turns every PlaceOrder into a server error.

claims.text: The alert reproduces exactly: the ratio of rate(STATUS_CODE_ERROR) over rate(all statuses) for checkout SERVER spans matching .*CheckoutService/PlaceOrder is 1 (100%) at each evaluation from 09:03:00Z through 09:06:00Z.

checkout span oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (SPAN_KIND_SERVER) had no STATUS_CODE_ERROR increase before the 09:03:54Z evaluation; the error increase then reads 3.85, 4.39 and 6.54 per 600s at 09:03:54Z, 09:04:54Z and 09:05:54Z, while the STATUS_CODE_UNSET series declines from ~8.8 to 5.56 over the same points.

Among checkout's client RPCs, only oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge shows a non-zero rpc_grpc_status_code="2" series, first appearing at the 09:02:54Z evaluation (0) and rising 1.52→4.05→5.05 per 600s; rpc_grpc_status_code="0" continued for CartService/GetCart, CartService/EmptyCart, CurrencyService/Convert, ProductCatalogService/GetProduct, ShippingService/GetQuote and ShippingService/ShipOrder through the end of the window.

payment's server span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge carries STATUS_CODE_ERROR with exactly the same increase values as checkout's errors (3.85, 4.39, 6.54 per 600s at 09:03:54Z–09:05:54Z), while payment's internal 'charge' span stays STATUS_CODE_UNSET at a steady ~9–11 per 600s.
payment's PaymentService/Charge server-span error ratio is 1 (100%) at every evaluation from 09:03:00Z through 09:06:00Z.

payment's failing spans carry grpc.error_name="Error", grpc.error_message and exception.message "Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold", with stacktrace 'at module.exports.charge (/usr/src/app/charge.js:37:13)', on spans of service payment (service_version 2.0.2) with durations 825, 674, 645 and 598 µs — a fast rejection thrown inside payment's own charge handler.

feature_flag_flagd_impression_total on the flagd pod (k8s_pod_name flagd-d6485586b-xskfj) reports feature_flag_key="paymentFailure" with feature_flag_result_variant="off" earlier in the window and shows a separate series with feature_flag_result_variant="100%" first appearing at the 09:01:54Z evaluation; the "off" series' 600s increase stays flat at ~87.16 from 09:00:54Z to 09:05:54Z (no further impressions), and feature_flag_flagd_result_reason_total for feature_flag_key="paymentFailure" shows the same transition.
payment is the only service with a grpc.flagd.* CLIENT span in the window: grpc.flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveFloat appears only from the 09:03:54Z evaluation (1.93, 1.46, 1.31 per 600s).

On flagd, the internal span flagSync first appears at the 09:02:54Z evaluation (1.93, 1.46, 1.31, 1.23 per 600s) and flagd server-span resolveFloat goes from 0 to 1.11 at the same point; flagd's flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream STATUS_CODE_ERROR series is present at ~1.11 per 600s throughout the whole hour, including before the incident.

payment's pod payment-6f7bc865d6-s8xt4 (image_id ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo@sha256:33f327b357617379bfa3b292f430d1f06e66e2872494125a40bae14d8fe57d87) and its ReplicaSet payment-6f7bc865d6 are present unchanged for the entire hour, and the flagd pod flagd-d6485586b-xskfj is likewise unchanged; checkout's pod switches from checkout-75684774cb-rrnkq (last seen 08:51:54Z) to checkout-677db95fd-g5vc9 (first seen 08:52:54Z).

The checkout rollout was configuration-only at the image level: old pod checkout-75684774cb-rrnkq and new pod checkout-677db95fd-g5vc9 both report image_id ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo@sha256:5ab0d7b9003206a32c72ef48b42a535c3f70565251d7d832f86fe9f249f16635, and kube_deployment_status_replicas_available for deployment checkout stayed at 1 for every sample in the window; kube_replicaset_owner shows the new ReplicaSet checkout-677db95fd from 08:52:54Z.

Error spans also appear at the same evaluation points for frontend (SPAN_KIND_CLIENT/INTERNAL/SERVER), frontend-proxy (CLIENT/SERVER) and load-generator (CLIENT), starting at 09:02:54Z–09:03:54Z, with counts that match checkout's error counts (3.85, 4.39, 6.54 per 600s); the trace sample shows load-generator POST http.status_code=500, frontend-proxy 'ingress' 500 and frontend POST 500 in the same traces as a failing payment Charge. ad and recommendation error-span series remain at their pre-existing ~1.11 per 600s baseline throughout.

The checkout Deployment rollout is not sufficient to explain the burst: checkout-677db95fd-g5vc9 was already running from 08:52:54Z, yet no checkout PlaceOrder error increase appears at any evaluation before 09:03:54Z, and the exception text and stack are inside payment's charge handler rather than checkout.

flagd does not show signs of being down or newly broken: its pod and ReplicaSet are unchanged for the hour, its EventStream STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans run at a steady ~1.11 per 600s both before and during the incident, and its resolveBoolean/resolveAnyValue/flagd.ofrep series continue at their normal levels; only resolveFloat and flagSync are new.

Primary hypothesis: the flagd feature flag paymentFailure changed to its 100% failure variant around 09:00:54Z–09:01:54Z, after which payment's charge handler threw 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' for every call, driving payment's Charge error ratio to 1.0 and checkout's PlaceOrder error ratio to 1.0. Supporting observations are the variant transition ('off' → '100%'), the first flagSync on flagd at ~09:02:54Z, payment being the only service that resolves a flagd float at ~09:03:54Z, and payment's sub-millisecond thrown exceptions.

Rejected as the cause of this burst: the checkout Deployment update in release rel-20261116085220. It was a configuration-only rollout (identical image digest) that completed by 08:52:54Z, checkout stayed at 1 available replica, and the failing code path and thrown exception are in payment, with payment's own span counts exactly equal to checkout's error counts.

Considered and not supported: that the new checkout build causes payment to reject request content (e.g. a bad token for a subset of users). charge calls fail at a 1.0 ratio, not a subset, payment's pod/image did not change, and the rejection is a throw at /usr/src/app/charge.js:37 occurring at the same time as the paymentFailure variant change and payment's first flagd float resolution.

Human follow-up: inspect the flag source that flagd serves (the definition of feature_flag_key paymentFailure) and its audit/change history around 09:00–09:02Z, and restore the flag to its 'off' variant; then confirm the PaymentService/Charge error ratio and the checkout PlaceOrder error ratio return to zero.

gaps: change_history is not an integrated data source in this Run, so who or what changed the paymentFailure flag value (and the exact change time) is unknown; the timing is inferred only from metric series transitions.
pod_logs is not integrated, so payment and flagd logs could not be inspected to confirm the flag value returned to the charge handler.

The Kubernetes object holding the flagd flag definitions (e.g. a ConfigMap or file/HTTP flag source) was not observable; kube-state-metrics series available here only cover deployment/replicaset/pod info, so the flag's owning object name cannot be confirmed.

The exact numeric value of the paymentFailure flag is not directly observed; only the feature_flag_result_variant label values "off" and "100%" are visible, and impression counters do not give the flag's value.

Trace evidence is a biased sample (12 of 120 rows read, 108 omitted); the full call graph for these failures is not established, and payment Charge error spans show parent references to spans that are not visible in the sample.
Span counts are span-level increases, not unique request counts, and the number of distinct affected end users or downstream customers was not measured.
next_steps: Check the flagd flag definition for feature_flag_key paymentFailure and its change history/audit trail around 2026-11-16T09:00–09:02Z.
If the paymentFailure flag is intentionally reverted, re-verify the payment Charge error ratio and the checkout PlaceOrder error ratio afterwards to confirm the causal link.
Review whether the checkout release rel-20261116085220 (rolled out 08:52:20Z) was expected and whether it should be kept, independently of this incident.
